pass.description: true only if every blocking criterion in the rubric is satisfied with evidence.

blocking.description: Things that must be fixed. Each entry must name the file, symbol, or command.

not_verified.description: Criteria you could not check, and why.

needs_human.description: true when the blocker is a DECISION rather than a DEFECT.

question.description: When needs_human is true: concrete choice with options named.

evidence.description: What you actually inspected. Required on pass and fail.
